resources.string: Optional. Keep games and progress the same on your devices, or save a backup

With a free squarechess.org account, your games, puzzle progress and buddy stay the same on your phone, tablet and the website. Square Chess works fully without an account, and nothing is sent until you sign in.
Finish signing in with your browser, then come back here.

Signing in opens squarechess.org in your browser, so you type your password there, not in Square Chess. After that, your games, puzzle progress, puzzle and game ratings, daily goal, repeat set, buddy, clothes and world are synced, with this device\'s model name for your list of signed-in devices.
Signs out on this device and ends its access to the account. Your games stay on this device.
Deletes your squarechess.org account and everything synced to it.

This deletes your squarechess.org account and all games, puzzle progress and settings synced to it, for every device. It cannot be undone. Games on this device stay here.\n\nTo confirm, enter your account password. It is sent only to squarechess.org.
Your account has been deleted. Your games are still on this device.
